content: Asɑ u bũu sɑ̃ɑru yinɑ
Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ win Hunde u Asɑriɑ, Odɛdin bii yɔɔwɑ.

Mɑ u dɑ Asɑn wuswɑɑɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Asɑ, wunɛ kɑ Yudɑbɑ, kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ, i swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ. Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ, ì n kɑ nùn yɔ̃rɑ. Ì n nùn kɑsu, i ko i nùn wɑ. Adɑmɑ ì n nùn deri, u koo mɑɑ bɛɛ deri.
N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Isirelibɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ deri. Bɑ ǹ yɑ̃ku kowobu mɔ be bɑ koo bu Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑbɑ sɔ̃ɔsi. Mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ Gusunɔn woodɑ ɡɑɑ mɔ.
Adɑmɑ ben nuku sɑnkirɑnu sɔɔ, bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinnin mi bɑ nùn kɑsu. Mɑ u tii bu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, be bɑ dumɔ kɑ be bɑ yɑrimɔ bɑ ǹ bɔri yɛndu mɔ. Domi tɑbu wɑ̃ɑwɑ tem kpuro sɔɔ.
Tɑbu wɑ̃ɑ bwesenu sɔɔ kɑ wusu sɔɔ. Domi Gusunɔwɑ u bu wɑhɑlɑ dɑbi ni suremɔ.
Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, i yɔ̃ro dim dim, kpɑ i ku mwiɑ kpɑnɑ. Domi i ko i bɛɛn kookoosun ɑre wɑ i mwɑ.

Ye Asɑ u Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Asɑriɑ, Odɛdin biin ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ u dɑm wɑ mɑ u bũu ni nu wɑ̃ɑ Yudɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn tem sɔɔ kpuro kpeerɑsiɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ wuu si bɑ mwɛɛrɑ sɔɔ Efɑrɑimun ɡuurɔ. Mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yeru seeyɑ te tɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun wuswɑɑɔ.

Mɑ u Yudɑbɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kɑ Efɑrɑimubɑ kɑ Mɑnɑsebɑ kɑ sere Simɛɔbɑ, be, be bɑ wurɑmɑ win mi Yudɑɔ. Domi Isirelibɑ dɑbirɑ tɑ wurɑmɑ Yudɑɔ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ wɑ mɑ Gusunɔ, Asɑn Yinni u kɑ nùn wɑ̃ɑ.
Mɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ wɔ̃ɔn suru itɑse sɔɔ. N deemɑ Asɑn bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbuse sɔɔrɑ mi.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, ɑrumɑni ye bɑ ɡurɑ sɔɔ, kɛtɛ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (700) kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ yiruwɑ (7.000) bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ.
Bɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ mɑ bɑ koo Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni kɑsuwɑ kɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru kpuro, kɑ ben bwɛ̃rɑ kpuro.
Ben wi u yinɑ u Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni kɑsu, bɑ koo yɛ̃ro ɡowɑ, bɑɑ ù n sɑ̃ɑn nɑ bukuro ǹ kun mɛ bii, tɔn durɔ ǹ kun mɛ tɔn kurɔ.
Mɑ bɑ bɔ̃ri yi wurɑmɔ kɑ dɑm Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ, mɑ bɑ nuku dobun kuuki mɔ̀ bɑ kɔbi kɑ ɡuunu soosimɔ.
Mɑ Yudɑbɑ kpuro bɑ nuku dobu kuɑ ben nɔɔ mwɛɛ te bɑ kuɑn sɔ̃. Domi bɑ tu kuɑwɑ kɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru kpuro. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kɑsu kɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru kpuro. Mɑ u bu tii sɔ̃ɔsi, u bu wɛ̃rɑbu wɛ̃ beri berikɑ.
Asɑ u mɑm Mɑɑkɑ win mɛro yɑrɑ bɑndun di. Domi u bwɑ̃ɑroku kuɑ Asitɑɑten sɔ̃. Mɑ Asɑ u ɡu kɔsukɑ muku muku u dɔ̃ɔ mɛni wɔwɑɔ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Sedoroni.
Adɑmɑ Asɑ u ǹ kpĩɑ u ɡunɡunu mi bɑ rɑ bũnu sɑ̃ kpuro kpeerɑsie bɑɑ mɛ u tii Gusunɔ wɛ̃ mɑm mɑm win wɑ̃ɑru kpuro sɔɔ.
Wi kɑ win tundo bɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ bwese bwesekɑ yi Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃. Mɑ u ye kpuro suɑ u kɑ dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Mɑ tɑbu yɔ̃rɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, sere n kɑ kuɑ Asɑn bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbuse sɔɔ.
